title: glass cutting board
text: glass cutting board. I have granite counter tops and I am always looks for ways to protect the counters when in use.  This is perfect in size and texture.  It's not a "bubbly" texture like a smaller one I have, it's more a "brushed" surface.  I think it will be easier on my knife blades, however, only time will tell.  I wanted glass because it can be sanitized and this CAN be put into the dishwasher.  I have to note here that the size I purchased, 16x20, doesn't fit standing up in the lower area of dishwasher because it would interrupt the spinning washer portion.  However, it does lay flat on the top rack.  It has very nice little silicone disc type feet that lift less than a 1/4" (eyeballing it).  The little feet keep it VERY sturdy in place.  The glass itself is fairly thin, but works well.  Besides being able to sanitize the glass surface, you can actually see my beautiful, brand new granite counter tops.  This was a very worthy investment in my mind.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem worthy.

product_metadata.title: Chop-Chop Glass Cutting Board Or Counter Saver, 16 x 20 Inches
